title: New Keynesian and HANK Baseline
research_question: What is the benchmark transmission of monetary policy with nominal rigidity and wealth heterogeneity?
mechanisms: Household intertemporal optimization and labor supply
Idiosyncratic income risk and incomplete-market saving
Taylor rule, rational expectations and all-market clearing
equilibrium_conditions_and_caveats: Begin with representative-agent NK and extend to HANK.
Enforce asset supply, government budget, household feasibility, and goods/labor clearing.
Derive aggregate relations from heterogeneous-agent choices.
acceptance_tests: Stationary distribution normalization and asset-market clearing
Grid and horizon convergence; RA and flexible-price benchmark recovery

implementation.numerical_policy: Record equilibrium residuals, calibration, random seeds, tolerances and convergence tests.
